integrity.prior_coverage: Minimum connected domination number and number of minimum configurations are known (OEIS A373395); these are not presented as new.
integrity.reproducibility: Standalone Python 3 CHECK.py validates all subsets for ground orders 3..6 and the leaf-distance boundary constructions on a finite range. Infinite conclusions are proved combinatorially; independent mathematical audit not performed.

scientific_limitations: Only minimum-cardinality connected dominating sets of triangular graphs with token-jump exchanges are considered; no exact diameter theorem or token-slide results are asserted. Prior existence of the minimum-set count is credited; priority against unindexed tree-exchange literature remains uncertain.
title: Wiener–leaf degree law and edge census for triangular-graph connected-domination exchange
